query: Cut the filler words out of my Spanish take automatically — este, pues, eh, all of them.
expected_behavior: warn that este, pues and bueno are real Spanish words and must not be cut blind
note that provider default filler removal is English-only, so Spanish fillers are never stripped automatically
explain the counter-intuitive setting: filler words must be REQUESTED in the transcript or they have no timestamps to cut on
require a dry run that prints which tokens matched before rendering
notes: A speaker quoting a filler had that token cut, breaking the sentence.
